subject: Activation blueprint: canary choreography, staged migration & training cadence

Subject: Activation blueprint: canary choreography, staged migration & training cadence

Hi Lydia —

Congrats again on signing. Attached is the first draft of the post-signature activation blueprint embedded in the MAP we discussed. The high-level approach we recommend for a low-risk production cutover is:

1) Canary window (2 weeks):
   - Day 0–3: deploy side-by-side canary ingest pipeline, 1% traffic, full observability (latency, token cost, error rates).
   - Day 4–10: expand to 10% once KV cache behavior validated; run synthetic evals against our acceptance prompt set.
   - Day 11–14: 30% load if SLA and regressions are green; begin scheduled training sessions.

2) Staged migration (3 waves):
   - Wave A (small cohort): pilot customers + internal ops runbook verification.
   - Wave B (regional subset): expand with throttled autoscale policies.
   - Wave C (full): shift default routing and retire fallback variant.

3) Training & enablement: two-week training cadence coordinated with your ops and platform teams. Week 1: admin runbook + incident playbook. Week 2: developer SDK walk-through and tuning session.

Key acceptance criteria (short):
- Latency P95 <= 250ms for critical routes in canary.
- No quality regressions (automated eval set pass rate >= 95%).
- Cost-per-token within agreed guardrails (±10%).

I've attached the MAP workbook with tentative dates and owners. Please review the canary checklist and training roster stubs (attachments).

Next steps / asks:
- Lydia: confirm the two-week canary window start date (we currently propose Mon 2025-06-02).
- Samir: confirm ops participants (names + emails) for runbook signoff.
- Marissa/Karthik: confirm resource owners on our side for the training sessions and monitoring shifts.

Attachment: Boreal_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: canary-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through.

—Connor

Connor — thanks for the clear breakdown. A few quick internal notes and resource commitments:

• Monitoring: I will own the timeline for dashboards and trace hooks. ETA to deliver hooks into their Datadog account: Fri 2025-05-30.
• Evals: Karthik, please allocate Eval Engineer for the first 10 days of the canary. We need synthetic and regression runs automated.
• Training: I can run the admin + runbook session (Week 1). Suggest we involve Solutions Engineering for the Week 2 dev session.

Risk & mitigations (to call out in the MAP):
- Risk: KV-cache warmup causing initial spike in latency.
  Mitigation: pre-timed warmup traffic + sticky routing to canary nodes.
- Risk: unexpected prompt regressions for templated workflows.
  Mitigation: freeze model variant in early window, run extra eval sweep on golden prompts.

I've uploaded a short canary-playbook quicksheet (internal) that I'll attach to the MAP before we share the client-facing version.

Attachment (internal): canary-playbook-internal-stub.pdf (pdf)

Samir will own the ops attendee list — Samir, please add the names and corporate emails so we can add them to training invites.

We can tentatively approve a start of Mon 2025-06-02 if the above two items are added. Also request a single-slide summary for our execs that calls out SLA risk and go/no-go criteria.
